learnings.problem: The fidelity validator treated an approved visual pattern wrapper as the composition contract and falsely reported its frozen layers as missing.
learnings.resolution: Resolve approvedVisualPattern.compositionContract before normalization and cover the nested current schema in the normalization self-test.

learnings.problem: Document-level width probes passed while a narrower shared showcase ancestor clipped the mobile page on both sides.
learnings.resolution: Validate every visible ancestor boundary in addition to document scroll width, and require the content rectangle to remain inside each clipping owner.
learnings.source: fresh Blind QA at 389 CSS pixels

learnings.problem: The current Button source capture was valid but one Evidence claim retained the hash of an older capture revision.
learnings.resolution: Bind every Evidence claim to the current captured file hash and cross-check it against the source timeline and Blind QA input manifest before handoff.

decisions.problem: The Demo passed desktop visual review before its real narrow-browser shell was exercised.
decisions.resolution: Keep desktop proof surfaces and normal phone routes separate, and require a real browser-width probe for both the page and its shared showcase ancestors.

ruleCandidates.problem: No-horizontal-overflow can be a false positive when overflow-hidden ancestors crop a wider child.
ruleCandidates.resolution: Promote ancestor content visibility and clipping-owner bounds to an explicit visual QA signal after confirmation in another brand.
